facts.fact: INSTAT's open data licence agreement grants a free, worldwide, non-exclusive licence to use, copy, modify, distribute and build derived products from its datasets, tables, indicators and dashboards, for commercial and non-commercial use, with source attribution; the document carries no date of its own and 2026-08-04 is its published date.

The agreement defines the licensed data as datasets, statistical tables and other products published by INSTAT on its official website, its open data portal or other official dissemination platforms; dated by the document's published date 2026-08-04.
